svg.title: WhatsApp bot — Don Vatio architecture
svg.desc: Full architecture of the WhatsApp bot connecting collaborators clients to Don Vatio API
svg.text: Webhook architecture · Docker · Event-driven · JWT auth

g.text: WhatsApp bridge via QR · Detects messages
Fires POST webhook on new message
Menu → email → PDF upload → API call → response
Signs token with JWT_SECRET · 60 min TTL
